payload.artist_html: N. R. Lonrich, A. Pérez-Moreno, V. Díez Díaz, X. Pereda-Suberbiola, N. Bardet & N.-E. Jalil
payload.credit_html: Modified from "A titanosaurian sauropod with South American affinities (Lognkosauria: Argentinosauridae) from the Late Maastrichtian of Morocco and evidence for dinosaur endemism in Africa"
payload.description_html: Late Maastrichtian dinosaurs of the latest Cretaceous Phosphates of Morocco, compared to a modern human and camel (Camelus dromedarius). Dinosaur genera depicted include Chenanisaurus, Phosphatotitan, Ajnabia, Taleta, and Minqaria, alongside several unnamed abelisaurid, hadrosaurid, and titanosaur specimens.
